# sheet-hyperobjects

> The open commons (CERN-OHL-W-2.0) of sheet hyperobjects — origami, kirigami, papercut traditions,
> pop-up and paper engineering, book structures, flexagons and paper dioramas — as parametric
> cartridges. Mounted by Pliego at `projects/`; validated by `pliego-spec` (hyperobjects-spec).
> Status: incubating; first cartridges being built.

Boundary: public repository. Operational detail lives in MADFAM's private ops repository under the
repo-boundary contract (docs/PUBLIC_REPO_BOUNDARY.md).

## Invariants

- One `<slug>/` per object at the root: `main.py`, `project.json`, `docs/README.md`; strict kebab slugs.
- Licence in two agreeing fields (`project.attribution.license`, `hyperobject.commons_license`) = CERN-OHL-W-2.0.
- `attribution.lineage[]` is required; heritage objects cite sources and credit their communities.
- Born quadrilingual: en, es, fr, pt. No machine-only translation.
- Never a copied designer crease pattern; every object generates its own geometry.
- No platform code, no prices, no client names, no per-cartridge licence files.
